_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Oslo lufthavn (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/NO-GAR). The station is under the terminal: the laser sees the surface only.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Withheld after the final research pass: no numbered platforms (under the terminal; OSM and Bane NOR's table don't number them). The edits keep the research (platform heights, structures, entrances, amenities) for when OSM or a walk adds what's missing.

platform_refs_source.r17848217: Bane NOR's track table platform objects track 2 run alongside osm:way/r17848217; tracks 2, 3, 23 from the register (banenor_platforms_NO.csv) run alongside osm:way/r17848217, read 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/NSR:StopPlace:269); BanInfo's track numbers were being re-issued then: check on site
